'''Mickey''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] whose deceased form appears during [[The Introduction]] for [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Mickey is a member of the [[Sindacco Family]] and runs [[Caligula's Palace|Caligula's Casino]] in the city of [[Las Venturas]]. [[Johnny Sindacco]], a leading representative of the Sindacco family, negotiates a deal with [[Leone Family]] don [[Salvatore Leone]] to fund the casino. Salvatore demands that Mickey be killed and that a third party, [[Ken Rosenberg|Ken "Rosie" Rosenberg]], be put in his place. Mickey is buried in a [[Mass Grave|hole]] near [[Area 69]] and [[Verdant Meadows]].

==Trivia==
*During gameplay in sandbox mode, the player can often see that there are six bodies in the mass grave. Hence, logically speaking, one of them has to be Mickey's.
